sign: Observatory town. Horoscopes read while you wait. Futures sold separately.
North: the Orrery Rift. East: Orrery Ridge. South: Cloudshadow Meadow. The Great Orrery: the brass door.

lines: Star Nurse Pell: Lie back and look up. Healing works better when you're counting stars instead of debts.
Lens Grinder Orla: I grind lenses all day. At dusk I look through them and see the same lies, only bigger.
Chart Boy Quill: I copy star charts for the Gilt House. I add one fake star to each. Nobody's noticed.
Retired Astronomer Serafin: I discovered a comet once. The Gilt House renamed it after a cousin. The cousin later fell off a balcony.
Seer Mirabel: I read futures for the Gilt House. I leave out the endings. They pay better that way.
Seer Mirabel: Yours is short. I mean the reading.
Night Nurse Wilhelmina: Sleep. The stars will still be lying when you wake up.
Copyist Lorenz: We copy the sky by hand. When a star goes missing we are told it was never there. We erase it very neatly.
Lens Seller Ines: Tonics, charts and lenses. Buy a lens and you will see your future. Buy a tonic and you will have one.
